topNews.text: The World’s First Giant Anteater Reintroduction Appears to Be Succeeding in Brazil
topNews.excerpt: It’s been almost 20 years since Argentina launched what was at the time the world’s first attempt at reintroducing the giant anteater to a landscape it had disappeared from. 19 years later, and the initiative has been nothing if not successful, with the local population growing from 0 to around 200 individuals. La Fundación Rewilding

topNews.text: Spreading Crushed Rock on Newly-Planted Forests Boosts Carbon Storing and Nutrients
